design_reference_scope: Website typography and spacing only. All geographic artwork retains the modified Setouchi AuthaGraph composition.

maps.title: Water
maps.world_caption: Rivers, coastlines, and generalized ocean depths.
maps.japan_caption: Japan and its surrounding seas, with the Setouchi reference point.
maps.world_alt: Modified AuthaGraph world map with blue ocean depths, wine-colored land, and branching rivers.
maps.japan_alt: Japan and neighboring seas, showing ocean depth bands, rivers, and a yellow Setouchi locator.

maps.title: Fiber
maps.world_caption: Submarine and terrestrial cable routes connect continents. Routes are schematic; source snapshots span 2022–2026.
maps.japan_caption: Japan’s cable landings and terrestrial networks. Amber ocean routes and green land routes; schematic locations.
maps.world_alt: World network map with amber submarine cables crossing oceans and green terrestrial fiber networks.
maps.japan_alt: Fiber routes around Japan, with amber cables extending into the Pacific and green routes over land.

maps.title: Atmosphere
maps.world_caption: Cloud, precipitation, aerosol, and radiation observations from 15–29 October 2026.
maps.japan_caption: Atmospheric observations from 15–29 October 2026. Missing daytime cloud retrievals do not mean clear sky.
maps.world_alt: Hexagonal atmospheric observation fields, including pink cloud patterns and blue precipitation, across the world on a light amber background.
maps.japan_alt: Atmospheric observation cells over Japan and nearby seas on a light amber background, with the Setouchi reference point.

maps.title: Temperature records · 2026
maps.world_caption: Daily land-temperature record counts through 28 October 2026. A partial-year count, not a temperature anomaly.
maps.japan_caption: The same daily record-count classes around Japan, through 28 October 2026.
maps.world_alt: Land-temperature record counts shown as orange, yellow, and pale hexagons on a modified AuthaGraph world map.
maps.japan_alt: Temperature record-count hexagons over Japan and neighboring land, with the Setouchi reference point.

maps.title: Starlink and the orbital sky
maps.world_caption: World atlas observer plate: San Francisco reference, 3 November 2026, 17:10 UTC. Starlink names and distinct vendor symbols.
maps.japan_caption: Setouchi observer at 34.45° N, 133.99° E, 29 October 2026, 20:00 UTC. Sky field and Japan locator shown together.
maps.world_alt: Calculated satellite positions across a dark wine sky, with Starlink names, colored vendor markers, and curved reference lines.
maps.japan_alt: Satellite positions for the Setouchi observer, with Starlink names and a separate Japan locator inset.
